title: Cache AuthRepository currentUuid in-flight Future
objective: Prevent concurrent currentUuid callers from racing duplicate SharedPreferences reads by caching the in-flight Future instead of only caching the resolved value.
acceptance_criteria: AuthRepository replaces the String? currentUuid cache with a Future<String?>? in-flight cache or equivalent single-flight mechanism
currentUuid concurrent callers share the same in-flight SharedPreferences fetch
isAuthenticated uses compatible cache semantics or remains correct with the new single-flight token/uuid fetch
login, signUp, logout, and validateSession invalidate or refresh the Future cache when auth state changes
IAuthRepository public getters and method signatures remain unchanged
flutter analyze for auth repository files reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated AuthRepository auth cache fields and getters
